feeds.title: The Talking Bee Blog
feeds.description: Sneha Dalvi, the founder of The Talking Bee blog is a travel professional and a foodie at heart. She is a food and travel blogger. The blog has a lot to offer for everyone. It includes restaurant, hotel and resort reviews from budget to luxury range, travel write ups for domestic as well as International destinations. She also writes about various recipes of home cooked food. She has ranked under top 5 food bloggers on Zomato's listing. She is an active contributor of various food and travel platforms.

feeds.title: Miniaturefoodie Tea Blog
feeds.description: Ashita Agrawal a.k.a Miniaturefoodie, is a food blogger based in Mumbai. She writes Tea Blogs, Restaurant Reviews, and also Recipes. She is a Computer Engineer living and working in Mumbai, India. When she is not working, she's out exploring the Restaurants & Street Food of Mumbai.

feeds.title: Aamchi Mumbai
feeds.description: We Are Food Explorers in Mumbai. For business inquiries mail me at : mehulmhingu@gmail.comFollow me on Instagram : @StreetFoodRecipe

feeds.title: DivineTaste
feeds.description: I'm Anushruti RK, a recipe developer, food writer and photographer based in Mumbai, specializing in pure vegetarian and sattvik recipes. DivineTaste.com catalogues my quest for simple and exotic pleasures in food that lead to tremendous overall well being with simple healthful recipes, at times elaborate with occasional indulgences!

feeds.title: Foodomania
feeds.description: I'm Kavitha Ramaswamy; part time Finance-lady and full time Nutella-lover. I started Foodomania in the fall of 2012 to document my culinary experiments and seek creative satisfaction. I am a lacto-vegetarian by birth (and by choice) and I like to cook fast, fresh and simple recipes.

feeds.title: Finely Chopped
feeds.description: I am a columnist for The Indian Express and NDTV Food and write for other publications. I have recently published a book called The Travelling Belly I am based in Mumbai.I love to travel and share my experiences from all over the world. This page is where I share my articles on food, blog posts and experiences from the world of food which appear on my blog. You will find recipes here. Feedback on restaurants. Stories of people I have met in the world of food.

feeds.title: Bombay Foodie
feeds.description: My name is Simmi Sareen and I have been writing Bombay Foodie for the last ten years. This blog is my place to tell food stories. But more importantly, this is the gateway for me to meet fellow foodies.

feeds.title: Rohanvsfood Blog
feeds.description: This is foodie Rohan a.k.a rohanvsfood, for me good food always sets the right mood as my Love for food is infinite and this will also leave your taste buds longing for more tastier and healthier food. Also love to travel to various places because it opens up various doors to try new cuisine.

feeds.title: 2FoodFreaks Blog
feeds.description: We're 2FoodFreaks or in simpler words, two best friends that are crazy about Food, obviously! We are Computer Engineers by the week and Food Bloggers on the weekends. Most of the times, you'd find us typing away to glory, be it codes or food reviews, or brainstorming about our baby blog. So come, join us in this food journey, we'd very much like you to be a part of it.

feeds.title: Grubzon - A Gourmet Voyage Blog
feeds.description: Grubzon started in Mumbai as a food blog to cover local restaurants and the food they offer. From there we have grown to showcasing food from around the world, discuss rarely known cooking techniques and much more. Grubzon intends to make rarely known food techniques mainstream, help restaurants with unique dishes, organize food meets and ultimately expose people to beautiful food from around the world.

feeds.title: Snehanvg Blog
feeds.description: A dentist by profession and a traveller and foodie by passion who likes to pen down her hogging memories by writing restaurant reviews.

feeds.title: Nonchalant Gourmand Blog
feeds.description: This blog is about life, its experiences and its engaging effect coupled with a propelling force which drives me to my ultimate destination - a world of food, cooking and creating dishes which I share through the eyes of my persona. This blog will open up an exciting world of food for you and my inexhaustible penchant for simplifying fine dishes from around the world and creating taste will entice you to whip the same in your kitchens. Bon Appetite!!

feeds.title: Sindhi Rasoi
feeds.description: Here you can view traditional Sindhi Vegetarian and Vegan Recipes. My name is Alka Keswani and I created this blog in 2008 when there was no mention of Sindhi cuisine online. Sindhi Rasoi is a chronicle of my childhood memories related to Sindhi food, food culture and traditions, and my (late) mom's recipes.

feeds.title: The Crazy Indian Foodie
feeds.description: Devashree Sanghvi is the founder and blogger at Thecrazyindianfoodie.She is a food and travel blogger, Zomato verified restaurant reviewer and social media influencer based in Mumbai. From street food to fine dining, brand reviews to destinations to luxury resorts to weekend gateways to events she's got it all covered on her blog. She's been featured in publications like Thebaysidejournal, Nearfox Mumbai and Afternoon DC amongst others.

feeds.title: Shobha's Food Mazaa
feeds.description: Food Mazaa is a one stop blend of many cuisines. Come let's have fun with the art of scrumptious cooking, the tantalizing sense of taste and the wonderful world of aromatic flavours .

feeds.title: The Spicy Cafe
feeds.description: The Spicy Cafe - An Indian food blog with a wide variety of recipes from curries, dals, vegetables, snacks, party appetizers, soups, salads, desserts and much more!
